$comment: Shape validation only. Required-ness is enforced per-template with helm's `required` function, so rendering one workflow template never demands another template's values.

template.$comment: Set by the renderer to the selected template; gates which template body evaluates (helm evaluates all templates even under -s).

publish.$comment: Emit per-run inputs as {{params.*}} tokens (a saveable template) instead of literals.

composable.$comment: Overlay mode: render a template as an overlay-able atom — implement omits its standalone commit-decision closer so a create-pr overlay supplies it. Set by `h template compose`.

slug.$comment: Git-branch-safe: lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen. Empty passes shape validation; the template rejects it via `required`.

repo.$comment: GitHub owner/name — the wf-registry identity segment. Identity only; NOT the clone path.

gitAuth.$comment: Git auth strategy name for worktree/clone + the push instruction; secrets stay in the agent env. Empty = the agent's GIT_AUTH default.

verify.$comment: verify overlay template (templates/verify.tmpl.yaml). cmd bakes from values at compose/publish time.

createPr.$comment: create-pr overlay template (templates/create-pr.tmpl.yaml). Publish-native: slug/createPr/issueNumber are fire-time params; only gitAuth bakes here.

armRevise.$comment: arm-revise overlay (templates/arm-revise.tmpl.yaml, docs/plans/workflow-watcher-registry.md §10): appends a register-cron step that arms a revise-until-merged recur cron at PR birth. cadence/maxFires are execution machinery, baked here.

bootstrapRepo.$comment: bootstrap-repo template (templates/bootstrap-repo.tmpl.yaml). Publish-native: repoName/spec/verifyCmd/plugins/visibility are fire-time params; only visibility default and models bake here.

visibility.$comment: Default GitHub repo visibility for newly created repositories.

plugins.$comment: Plugin provisioning. marketplaces bake at publish time (curated config); which plugins to install is the fire-time `plugins` param (space-separated name@marketplace tokens).
